title: FreeCAD import/export control-flow and codec-evidence split
scope: Source-only cross-check of FreeCAD's current DWG converter wrapper and downstream DXF importer, with a route-specific reconciliation against existing libdxfrw qualification owners.

sources.name: FreeCAD Import/Export Preferences
sources.observation: The documented DWG conversion preference distinguishes Automatic from an explicitly selected converter. FreeCAD requires an external converter; DXF preferences also affect the DWG route. Documentation is mutable and not a runtime result.

sources.name: FreeCAD current importDWG.py
sources.observation: Current source tries LibreDWG, ODA, and QCAD in sequence in Automatic mode. DWG-to-DXF conversion checks intermediate-path existence after communicate(), not child status. The ODA command requests ACAD2000 DXF. DXF-to-DWG conversion returns the requested output path after a converter call without checking output existence/status. Mutable main was read on 2026-10-19; no immutable source SHA or executable was obtained.

sources.name: FreeCAD issue #31835
sources.observation: The still-open report describes Automatic DXF-to-DWG export stopping after a failed first converter because convertToDwg() returns unconditionally. The report names FreeCAD 1.1.3 on Windows, LibreDWG 0.14, and ODA File Converter 27.1.0; these are reporter-attributed results, not reproduced here and not a libdxfrw defect.

sources.name: FreeCAD Draft DXF guide
sources.observation: FreeCAD documents separate C++ and legacy Python DXF import routes and states that embedded ACIS/SAT solid data cannot currently be read by its stock DXF importer.

sources.name: FreeCAD C++ DXF importer source
sources.observation: The C++ importer has a specific entity dispatch/object construction path; importer selection and feature preferences are part of the consumer route rather than evidence about the converter alone.

plan_delta: Keep explicit LibreDWG-to-FreeCAD import qualification separate from FreeCAD Automatic fallback; Automatic may choose ODA or QCAD and is not a codec-specific result without child-process provenance.
Capture subprocess status, fresh output digest, actual DXF version, strict DXF parse, selected importer/backend, and per-source object disposition as separate outcomes.
For FreeCAD DXF-to-DWG export, require file existence, size, actual DWG magic/version, and independent reopen; the wrapper-returned path alone is not a success signal.
Keep stock FreeCAD's documented ACIS limitation outside the B-rep semantic evidence gate.
limitations: No FreeCAD, LibreDWG, ODA, or QCAD executable was run.
FreeCAD main source is mutable and was not resolved to an immutable revision in this pass.
No issue attachment or external drawing was downloaded; no fixture was added.
No new local defect, numbered finding, top-level subplan, dependency, or support claim was established.
